build.buildCommand: npm ci && NODE_OPTIONS=--max_old_space_size=4096 npm run build -w apps/web

deploy.startCommand: chmod +x apps/pocketbase/pocketbase && ./apps/pocketbase/pocketbase serve --http=0.0.0.0:8090 --dir=apps/pocketbase/pb_data --migrationsDir=apps/pocketbase/pb_migrations --hooksDir=apps/pocketbase/pb_hooks --encryptionEnv=PB_ENCRYPTION_KEY & npm run start --prefix apps/api
